title: Degree-zero geometric open restriction square for pinned tensor counits
statement: The geometric pinned single-degree open restriction square [def-pc-derived-base-change-map], with restrictions [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps], holds for single complexes in degree zero. With cartesian f,g,g′,f′ [def-pc-fibre-product], V⊆S, W⊆S′, W⊆g⁻¹V, U=f⁻¹V, fA=f|V, gA=g|W, P=U×_V W, p:P→U and q:P→W, there are natural isomorphisms a and b between the restricted global source/target functors and the local source/target functors, and the base-change composites followed by the composition-pinned single tensor counits [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition] commute with a,b for every module G. All categories and additive tensor functors are as in [def-pc-derived-category] and [def-pc-module-pullback].

lean.statement:
theorem open_pinned_single_degree_zero_square
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : Y ⟶ Z), (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).Additive]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (V : S.Opens) (W : S'.Opens) (hWV : W ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
    let U := f ⁻¹ᵁ V
    let fA := f ∣_ V
    let gA := g.resLE V W hWV
    let p := pullback.fst fA gA
    let q := pullback.snd fA gA
    let R := (schemeOpenRestriction S' W).mapDerivedCategory
    ∃ a : singleDegreeBaseChangeSource.{u, w} f g 0 ⋙ R ≅
        schemeOpenRestriction X U ⋙ singleDegreeBaseChangeSource.{u, w} fA gA 0,
    ∃ b : singleDegreeBaseChangeTarget.{u, w} g' f' 0 ⋙ R ≅
        schemeOpenRestriction X U ⋙ singleDegreeBaseChangeTarget.{u, w} p q 0,
    ∀ G : X.Modules,
      R.map (singleDegreeBaseChangeComposite f g g' f' sq.w 0 G) ≫ b.hom.app G =
        a.hom.app G ≫
          singleDegreeBaseChangeComposite fA gA p q pullback.condition 0
            ((schemeOpenRestriction X U).obj G)
